This '''pin-up of a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]]''' was a decorative poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
This image was painted by [[Justin Ridge]], and was developed for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode [[Rookies (episode)|''Rookies'']], even though the pin-up is not seen in the actual episode. The person is wearing the same outfit as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].

The poster can be seen gracing the walls in the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Christophsis Republic base]] in ''[[The Hidden Enemy]]'', in [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] in ''[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]'', and [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] and [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate outpost]] in ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]''.
[[File:TiggsLeo-LT.png|thumb|right|170px|The poster can be seen behind the bar, along with pin-ups of a [[Hutt pin-up/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Soldier pin-up/Legends|soldier]] and a [[Rodian pin-up/Legends|Rodian]].]]
